name: psv-agent-remote
description: Connect local Codex sessions to your PlayStation Vita remote.

scripts.package: npm run prepare-runtime && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out dist/psv-agent-remote-0.1.0.vsix

commands.title: PSV Agent Remote: Disconnect This Window
PSV Agent Remote: Start Kiro Session
PSV Agent Remote: Stop Kiro Session
PSV Agent Remote: Show on Vita

psvAgentRemote.autoStart.description: Connect Codex sessions automatically when VS Code starts. In a Remote SSH window this runs on the remote host, next to Codex.

psvAgentRemote.pythonPath.description: Python 3.11+ executable path on the machine running the workspace. Empty searches standard installations. No pip install is needed.

psvAgentRemote.experimentalIpc.description: Discover VS Code Codex sessions through the version-dependent frontend IPC interface.

psvAgentRemote.brokerHost.description: MQTT broker address, as reached from the machine running the workspace (set it per Remote SSH host). Empty uses that machine's PSV Agent Remote configuration.

psvAgentRemote.brokerPort.description: MQTT broker port, used when brokerHost is set.

psvAgentRemote.hostId.description: Stable host identity. Empty uses the hostname of the machine running the workspace.

psvAgentRemote.ipcSocket.description: Optional Codex frontend Unix socket path.

psvAgentRemote.stateDatabase.description: Optional read-only Codex thread index path.

psvAgentRemote.appServerSockets.description: Existing shared CLI App Server Unix socket paths. Configure once per runtime, not per session.

psvAgentRemote.maxSessions.description: Maximum number of managed Codex sessions.
